spans.s: † धि धि, i. 6, Par. To hold (akin to धा).
-धि (vb. धा, form of an old ptcple., धन्त्, cf. ऊधन्, पयोधस् and पयोधि), latter part of comp. nouns, The receptacle for keeping that which the preceding part denotes; cf. e. g. अम्बु-धि.
† धी धी, i. 4, Ātm. (properly pass. of धा), To hold, to disregard, or to accomplish.
